purpose: Keep the custom 3DLINE DWG writer from emitting non-finite values that the paired parser refuses.

authority.formatScope: 3DLINE uses this repository's registered custom class; the ODA v5.4.1 entity tables do not define a 3DLINE body profile.
authority.localContract: DRW_3DLine::parseDwg reads six endpoint coordinates, three extrusion components and thickness as bounded raw doubles, and refuses every non-finite value before publishing the entity.

implementation.behavior: The custom-class DWG writer now checks both endpoints, extrusion components and thickness for finiteness before staging its raw-double body.
implementation.scope: Writer/parser consistency for this custom profile only; no standard DWG 3DLINE support claim is made.

generatedControls.failureRetry: Each refusal preserves a seeded destination. Corrected same-writer output reads back exact fields with zero entity/object parse failures.
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: Locally authored generated files only; no fixture was added.

limitations: This proves custom writer/parser consistency only; it does not establish interoperability with external producers or consumers.
The broader P6 no-loss and platform qualification gates remain open.
supportClaimEffect: Closes a bounded local custom-class finite-field writer gap; no standard DWG support claim is promoted.
